actionable_requirements.description: Ingest and backfill at least 120 authentic mature transaction outcomes into model_ready.valuation_view.
Ensure zero synthetic rows, auto-seeded entries, or copied prediction substitutions are present.
Verify P10..P90 interval coverage >= 80% and median calibration ratio between 0.95 and 1.05 on aligned populations.
Record RBAC/ABAC confidential access audit receipts without leaking raw transaction values.
